task.outcome:
Correct pipx installation ownership detection for equivalent filesystem paths.
Confirmed at d8543630b5a4fe4f01d695ac25b9bc89204a7245. Owner: mempalace_code/updater.py:718-765, detect_installation. docs/UPDATES.md Boundary supports pipx isolated installs. env_prefix is resolved but PIPX_HOME is only expanded. A disposable custom root with no literal pipx path component, under macOS temporary-directory alias, returns supported kind=pipx when PIPX_HOME is physical and unsupported/ambiguous when it names the same directory lexically. samefile control=true; same manager callable and metadata control used. Previous installed 1.15.0 wheel pipx smoke returned unsupported ambiguous virtual environment. Actual default symlink-free installations are not claimed broken.
Evidence: .codex-local/release-prep-20261002/bug-intake/reproduction.json (pipx_alias), .codex-local/release-prep-20261002/pipx-status-diagnostic.json. Smallest proposed correction: normalize compared paths in existing detector, preserve installer ownership guards. No code fix performed during intake.

exclusions: Credentials, paid AI clients in release gates, real user conversation data and writes outside this repository.
New update controllers, architecture boundaries, weaker guards or assertions, unrelated changes.
Push, tag, release publication and changes to live palaces or services.

acceptance.assertion: Canonical and symlink/alias PIPX_HOME paths to the same disposable custom pipx root give the same supported pipx result with a discoverable manager.
acceptance.verification: Use actual detect_installation; custom root has no literal pipx segment. Positive physical-path control, alias-path case, identical manager/extras and installed noneditable metadata; no live installs.

acceptance.assertion: Existing refusal boundaries remain intact: absent manager, non-pipx plain/system/editable environments and unrelated roots stay unsupported.
acceptance.verification: Run tests/test_updater.py with focused regression cases; do not remove ownership checks or infer supported ownership from a manager alone.

acceptance.assertion: The supported installed pipx CLI reports pipx ownership after the same-owner correction, using manager discovery independently valid in its probe environment.
acceptance.verification: Rebuild exact wheel and reproduce disposable pipx update-status scenario after RELEASE-INSTALL-PROBE-MANAGER-PATH; no package/service update is applied.
